name: boat stretch
description: A seated V position, balancing on the sit bones with the legs raised. It works the abs and hip flexors and stretches the backs of the legs.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your hands on the floor behind you.
Lean back slightly with a long spine and lift your feet.
Straighten your legs up into a V shape.
Reach your arms toward your shins and hold for a few breaths.
Bend your knees and lower your feet to the floor.
